ev.q: A total of 158 cases of COVID-19 were diagnosed among undergraduate students during March 15–May 3, 2021
Among 140 infected students who were interviewed, 89 (63.6%) reported recent travel outside Chicago during spring break
Three (1.9%) students with COVID-19 reported being fully vaccinated
Figure is a histogram showing date of onset and viral lineage among 158 undergraduate students
Three (1.9%) students with COVID-19 reported being fully vaccinated
Among the students who traveled together, some travel groups had the same lineage
On April 7, 2021, the university notified CDPH of 37 students with positive SARS-CoV-2 test results

methods_quotes.q: Similar sequences (differing by fewer than five nucleotides) were assumed to represent a single viral introduction.
Descriptive and social network analyses were completed using R (version 4.1.0; R Foundation) and MicrobeTrace (version 0.7.0; CDC), respectively.
